MERIDIAN MECHANICAL SYSTEMS
Commercial HVAC & Mechanical Construction - Norfolk, VA
PROPOSAL SUMMARY
Proposal Date: September 3, 2026
Submitted To: Crestmark Construction Partners
Attention: Renee Ostrander, Senior Mechanical Estimator
Project: Harborview Medical Office Building
Project Number: 27-0212
Bid Package: 27-0212-BP-23 - Division 23 Mechanical / HVAC
Base Bid: $398,500.00
Bid Validity: 30 calendar days from the Proposal Date
This proposal is based on Contract Drawings Revision 2 and the Project Manual issued for bid, and covers the full Division 23 mechanical scope described in the sections that follow.

MERIDIAN MECHANICAL SYSTEMS
SCOPE OF WORK
The following scope is included in our Base Bid of $398,500.00:
1 Mechanical mobilization and on-site supervision for the duration of our work.
2 Furnish and install all rooftop units (RTUs) shown on the mechanical Contract Drawings.
3 Ductwork distribution and insulation throughout, per the Contract Drawings and Project Manual.
4 Hydronic piping and specialties serving the mechanical rooms and air-handling equipment.
5 Integration of our equipment with the building automation system (BAS) specified in Section 23 09 00.
6 Testing, adjusting, and balancing (TAB) of all air and water systems per Section 23 05 93.
7 Mechanical permit fees associated with our Division 23 scope of work.
8 Support for third-party commissioning, including functional testing coordination.
Meridian Mechanical Systems - Harborview Medical Office Building, Project 27-0212, Bid Package 27-0212-BP-23

MERIDIAN MECHANICAL SYSTEMS
CLARIFICATIONS AND EXCLUSIONS
This proposal is based on the Contract Drawings (Revision 2) and Project Manual issued for bid. The following items are excluded from our Base Bid:
1 Performance and payment bond. Excluded from the Base Bid; available as an add-alternate if required by Crestmark.
2 Electrical power connections to mechanical equipment - by others (Division 26).
Refrigerant handling is included as part of our standard installation practice; a separate EPA-compliance documentation package is not addressed in this proposal and would need to be confirmed with Crestmark if required as a deliverable.

MERIDIAN MECHANICAL SYSTEMS
COMMERCIAL AND SCHEDULE TERMS
Anticipated duration is 20 weeks from mobilization, subject to an approved project schedule. This proposal remains valid for 30 calendar days from the Proposal Date stated on Page 1.
Respectfully submitted,
Carlos Mendieta
Senior Estimator, Meridian Mechanical Systems
carlos.mendieta@meridian-mech-demo.example

award.narrative: Recommend award to Meridian Mechanical Systems at $408,500 leveled, scoring 94.9 of 100, ahead of Vantage HVAC Group at 93.2 (1.7 points). This is not the cheapest eligible bid. Palmetto Mechanical Contractors is $1,600 lower leveled, and the weighted model still prefers Meridian Mechanical Systems on non-price factors. Strongest factor is schedule and capacity at 100 of 100 (26 weeks inside the 26-week requirement, 9-person crew); weakest is safety record at 88 (EMR 0.90 on a scale where 0.85 scores 100 and 1.25 scores 0). Weights applied: leveled cost 40%, experience and past performance 30%, safety record 20%, schedule and capacity 10%.

prequalification.policy_note: Safety and insurance are gates, not weights. A subcontractor over the EMR maximum or under a required insurance limit is removed from award consideration before price is discussed, because carrying that risk is not something a lower number buys back.

coverage.policy_note: A package with fewer than three responsive bidders is not competitively bid, and the leveled spread stops being evidence of a market price. Coverage is tracked from the invitation out, not from the bids in, because the bids that never arrived are the ones that do not show up in any comparison.
